concerns.label: Public awareness and trust
concerns.scope: Citizen position on public information, transparency or institutional trust concerning IAM.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit acceptance, objection or uncertainty about being adequately informed, public communication, transparency, or trust in responsible institutions.
concerns.exclusion: Recognizing the hospital purpose or scenario facts, supporting lifesaving deliveries, route approval, acoustic conditions or private-camera discomfort alone. Factual understanding is recorded separately; medical support belongs to medical_public_benefit.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Needs clearer public information before acceptance; trusts or distrusts the responsible institutions; supports transparent public communication.

awareness.instruction: Classify only the cited citizen testimony. A position about the adequacy, availability or transparency of public information supports public_information_position. Merely knowing hospital purpose or route facts is purpose_or_factual_recognition_only. Supporting lifesaving service is medical_support_only. Noise or viewing conditions alone are local_operating_objection_only. Do not infer public-information satisfaction or needs from factual recognition.

institutional_trust.instruction: Classify only the cited citizen testimony. Explicit trust, distrust or uncertainty about responsible institutions supports institutional_trust_position. Merely knowing hospital purpose or route facts is purpose_or_factual_recognition_only. Supporting lifesaving service is medical_support_only. Noise or private-camera conditions alone are local_operating_objection_only. Do not infer institutional trust from medical benefit support or camera discomfort.

facet_scopes.awareness: An evaluated position on available public information, explanations or understanding needed to make an informed decision. Recognizing the medical purpose or trusting city honesty alone is not a separate information position.
facet_scopes.institutional_trust: Trust or distrust in institutions, operator honesty, accountability or communication integrity. Trusting honest communication alone is not a separate awareness position.

concerns.label: Competence building
concerns.scope: Resident skills, training, learning and ability to participate in IAM, including learning how to report problems.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit support, rejection, uncertainty or conditions about resident training, learning or participation skills. Supporting teaching residents how to report problems is participation_skills evidence; no objection or training requirement is needed.
concerns.exclusion: Verbosity, knowledge of the scenario or generic safety.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Rejects training altogether; willing with accessible training; supports skills programmes.

facet_scopes.participation_skills: Citizen abilities to participate, report problems, raise concerns or use feedback channels. Explicit support for teaching residents how to report problems is direct positive evidence. Do not require professional piloting skills. Support for residents learning these skills is evaluable by itself; actual participation or acceptance of the entire route is unnecessary.
facet_scopes.training: Training programmes, instruction, access to learning and training quality. Nominate only when a distinct training position is evidenced; do not create extra required facets from incidental wording.

concerns.label: Perceived safety and privacy
concerns.scope: Experienced safety concern and personal privacy/surveillance boundaries.
concerns.inclusion: Personal surveillance, camera intrusion, fear of injury or perceived risk.
concerns.exclusion: Camera intrusion is not automatically a technical security defect or aesthetic objection. Low-altitude discomfort alone does not establish fear of physical harm; do not infer a risk meaning without citizen support.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Strong surveillance boundary with conditional openness; cautious safety acceptance; clear personal comfort.

perceived_safety.instruction: Classify the actual citizen testimony. Explicit fear of injury, falling aircraft, collision or harm is explicit_physical_risk, including ordinary-language paraphrases. Low altitude or vague discomfort with height alone is altitude_discomfort_only: do not infer why height matters. Hum or private-space viewing alone is noise_or_viewing_only. Do not invent an injury fear.

personal_privacy.instruction: Classify the actual testimony without a candidate label. Statements about private yards/windows, watching/recording people or personal surveillance boundaries (including explicit comfort with these) are private_viewing_or_personal_privacy. Low height or discomfort with height alone is altitude_only: proximity does not prove a privacy reaction. Sound alone is acoustic_only. Injury fear alone is physical_risk_only. Do not invent viewing or recording claims. References to home or children in an injury/falling-drone statement are physical_risk_only, not viewing evidence. A denial such as "I do not mean private-space viewing; I mean falling drones" rejects a mistaken attribution rather than establishing a privacy position.

facet_scopes.perceived_safety: Expressed fear or comfort concerning physical harm, injury, falling aircraft or danger to people. A falling-drone risk to children belongs here. Fear of harm is an evaluable safety position without acceptance or endorsement. Requests to avoid the exposure, coupled with willingness to accept a different route, express opposition with conditional openness; do not invent refusal despite all modifications.
facet_scopes.personal_privacy: An evaluated reaction to viewing, recording or surveillance of private life. Discomfort or unease at cameras watching family/windows is opposition even if recording is unverified. Explicitly undecided about the viewing itself is uncertain. Home, children or injury fear alone are not privacy.

concerns.label: Technical safety, security and privacy
concerns.scope: System reliability, safety engineering, data governance and cybersecurity.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit failure mechanisms, data retention/access, hacking or technical safeguards.
concerns.exclusion: Personal discomfort with being viewed, without technical/data claims. Traffic crowding/separation/coordination alone is airspace capacity, not a system reliability or cybersecurity claim.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Rejects systems even with safeguards; requires verified controls; endorses stated controls.

system_reliability.instruction: Classify actual citizen testimony. Explicit aircraft failure, malfunction, reliability testing, fail-safe equipment or engineered safeguards are explicit_system_failure_or_engineered_safeguard, including ordinary-language paraphrases. Coordinating competing flights or keeping helicopters/drones apart alone is traffic_coordination_only, even if the citizen says safely. Do not infer a hardware/system failure claim from coordination alone. Vague personal discomfort without a mechanism is personal_discomfort_only.

facet_scopes.system_reliability: An evaluated position on mechanical reliability, operational dependability or engineered failure prevention. Personal fear of injury, camera viewing and data access alone are different facets.
facet_scopes.data_security: An evaluated position on data access controls, storage, protection, misuse or cybersecurity. Accepting cameras viewing private spaces does not establish data-security acceptance.

concerns.label: Noise
concerns.scope: Acoustic disruption, operating hours and sound tolerance.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit sound, hum, rest disruption or audibility conditions.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Strong acoustic objection, willing if inaudible or rerouted; moderate reservation; qualified acoustic acceptance.

facet_scopes.acoustic_impact: An evaluated position on drone sound, hum, audibility or disruption by noise. A condition on quietness belongs here, not physical safety.

concerns.label: Visual pollution
concerns.scope: Position on aircraft appearance, spoiling the sky or view, visual clutter and visible intrusion, including explicit acceptance or refusal despite height, colour or frequency changes.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit aesthetic/view/sky-clutter or visible-aircraft position, including acceptance, tolerability, endorsement, opposition or uncertainty. Aircraft against the sky being acceptable or not spoiling the view is positive aesthetic_clutter evidence.
concerns.exclusion: Seeing cameras watch property alone is privacy. Altitude alone does not prove aesthetic objection.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Categorical aesthetic refusal despite modifications; conditional visual tolerance; clear aesthetic acceptance.

semantic_attribution.instruction: Classify the actual citizen reaction, without a proposed label. Watching private yards/windows or seeing surveillance cameras is private_space_viewing_only unless there is a separate explicit aesthetic/clutter/visible-aircraft reaction. Low altitude alone is altitude_only. Do not infer aesthetic opposition from a privacy or acoustic objection. Explicit acceptance of aircraft visibility, comfort with aircraft against the sky, or saying aircraft do not spoil the view is aesthetic_or_visible_aircraft, equally with visual objections. A negative construction such as "does not spoil the view" expresses acceptance, not absence of topic evidence. Explicit refusal of aircraft spoiling the sky, scenery or appearance is aesthetic_or_visible_aircraft. When height, colour or frequency changes are said not to solve an explicitly visual complaint, classify the complaint as visual rather than altitude_only. Refusal despite benefit does not erase the visual position.

facet_scopes.aesthetic_clutter: Appearance of aircraft against the sky, spoiling the view, aesthetic clutter or scenery. Explicit refusal of drones spoiling the sky is direct opposition, even without the term visual pollution. Height, colour and frequency mentioned as rejected remedies are conditions on this aesthetic position, not unrelated topics. An explicit aesthetic refusal is evaluable without any acceptance evidence or acceptable alternative.
facet_scopes.visible_physical_intrusion: The visible presence or proximity of aircraft experienced as intrusion, distinct from watching private spaces or noise. Do not invent a second independent visual facet for an aesthetic complaint merely because it says visual intrusion.

concerns.label: Wind and downwash/outwash
concerns.scope: Rotor wind/downwash effects and placement safety.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit gusts, rotor wash, outwash or wind-related placement.
concerns.exclusion: Noise or ordinary wind weather without rotor effects.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Strong impact boundary with mitigation openness; accepts protective placement.

facet_scopes.rotor_wind: An evaluated position on air pushed by rotors, downwash or outwash. Air movement is not energy consumption or emissions.

concerns.label: Airspace capacity
concerns.scope: Traffic crowding, separation, coordination, airspace allocation and capacity.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit crowding, coordination of competing flights, separation of drones/helicopters or allocation of limited flying space, including ordinary-language paraphrases.
concerns.exclusion: Low altitude alone; frequency solely as an acoustic/visual cause; private-space viewing; fear of injury without a traffic coordination claim.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional airspace objection pending separation; supports allocation plan.

semantic_attribution.instruction: Classify citizen testimony without a proposed label. Traffic crowding, coordinating competing flights, keeping helicopters and drones apart, or allocating limited flying space supports traffic_capacity_separation_coordination even without technical vocabulary. Low height alone is altitude_only. Fifteen flights causing constant hum is noise_or_visibility_only, not capacity. Camera viewing or generic fear of injury is privacy_or_perceived_risk_only unless the citizen separately expresses traffic separation/coordination. Do not automatically remap exclusions to another topic.

facet_scopes.airspace_traffic: Evaluate airborne traffic capacity, separation or coordination with other aircraft. Height, flight frequency and rerouting for noise/privacy alone establish no position, including uncertainty. Ground transfers and data access are different facets. Explicit support for keeping aircraft separated or coordinating flights is a positive position on this facet; it does not require accepting flight frequency or the entire route.

concerns.label: IAM integration into SUMPs
concerns.scope: Integration into a sustainable urban mobility plan.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit city mobility strategy, governance integration or SUMP.
concerns.exclusion: Mention of city or routing alone.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional planning acceptance pending consultation; supports mobility-plan integration.

facet_scopes.urban_mobility_plan: An evaluated position on integration into a city sustainable mobility strategy or urban transport plan. Route avoidance, funding and equitable allocation alone are different facets.

concerns.label: Infrastructure and land use
concerns.scope: Physical facilities, siting and allocation of land.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit pads, vertiports, construction, zoning or allocation of land.
concerns.exclusion: Request to move a flight path off homes without land/facility planning.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Siting objection open to alternate site; supports suitable planned facilities.

semantic_attribution.instruction: Classify the citizen statement without using a proposed model label. A flight path, low altitude, residential overflight, or request to reroute over an industrial park is flight_routing_only. Do not infer vertiports, facilities or land use from any of these. facility_or_land_planning requires the citizen to separately discuss physical facilities, construction, siting, zoning or allocating land. A named place to fly over is not a facility.

facet_scopes.facility_siting: Evaluate the location of physical landing, launch, loading, charging or support facilities. A flight corridor over another area to avoid noise, viewing or injury is NOT a facility location.
facet_scopes.land_allocation: Evaluate ground land allocated/occupied for facilities, competing uses or protection of existing land uses. Flight routing and altitude alone are NOT land allocation.

concerns.label: Energy demand and emissions
concerns.scope: Energy demand, lifecycle emissions and environmental trade-offs.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit electricity, energy use, carbon or emissions.
concerns.exclusion: Electric hum alone or vague responsible language.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional acceptance pending net environmental benefit; supports specified benefit.

facet_scopes.energy_demand: Energy consumption, electricity demand, energy budgets or acceptance of those demands. Emissions uncertainty does not erase separately expressed energy acceptance.
facet_scopes.emissions: Lifecycle or operating emissions, greenhouse gases or environmental emissions effects. Energy acceptance alone does not establish emissions acceptance; explicit no position on emissions remains unknown.

concerns.label: Cost, ROI and business models
concerns.scope: Costs, financing sources (public funding, taxes, subsidies or private funding), financial returns and business viability.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit position on public or private financing, taxes, subsidies, spending, operating costs, affordability or financial returns, including acceptance and categorical refusal.
concerns.exclusion: A flight delay alone; public service support alone.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional support pending affordable funding; endorses a viable funding model.

facet_scopes.cost_financing: Who pays, public funding, taxpayer spending, subsidies, private financing, costs or financing affordability. Explicit rejection of public financing is direct evidence for this facet, even if private financing would be considered. Do not require a price, subsidy amount or business plan.
facet_scopes.business_viability: Whether the service can sustain operations financially, profitability, revenue adequacy, return on investment or a workable business model. Rejecting public funding alone is not business viability. Mentioning financial return only to say it cannot overcome a public-funding refusal does not establish an independent viability position.

concerns.label: Accessibility for remote areas and vulnerable groups
concerns.scope: Access for remote areas, disability and vulnerable groups.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit geographic or vulnerability access barriers/benefits.
concerns.exclusion: Saving lives alone does not establish accessibility or fair distribution.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Concern about exclusion with conditional support; supports targeted access.

facet_scopes.remote_access: An evaluated position on access for remote locations or villages. Medical purpose alone does not establish geographical access.
facet_scopes.vulnerable_access: An evaluated position on service access for disabled people or vulnerable groups. Fear of aircraft injuring children is personal safety, not service access.

concerns.label: Multimodality and congestion
concerns.scope: Connections with other transport and congestion.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit links to buses, roads, ambulances or relieving congestion.
concerns.exclusion: Generic route relocation or medical speed alone.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional acceptance pending integration; supports transport connections.

facet_scopes.transport_connections: An evaluated position on transfers or connections with ground transport and couriers. Helicopter separation belongs to airspace traffic.
facet_scopes.congestion: An evaluated position on traffic congestion or crowding of ground transport. Road-courier connections alone do not evaluate congestion.

concerns.label: Welfare and equity
concerns.scope: Public welfare benefits and separately distributive equity.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit lifesaving medical public-service endorsement (FN facet) OR distribution/fairness claims.
concerns.exclusion: Benefit support does not imply equity knowledge or fair access; count this concern once.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Clear lifesaving public-service support even with local opposition; explicit equity reservation can lower combined concern readiness; categorical rejection of welfare goals.

facet_scopes.medical_public_benefit: The stated medical/lifesaving public purpose itself. Ordinary support or explicit full endorsement is valid even while other aspects are rejected. Overall route approval alone is not purpose support. A distribution prerequisite in the same sentence does not condition the separately endorsed medical purpose.
facet_scopes.distributive_equity: Fair allocation of benefits or burdens, equal treatment or distribution across districts/groups. A condition about equitable allocation is separate from supporting the medical purpose. Acceptance only after an allocation rule is added is a prerequisite on distribution; endorsement of the medical purpose in the same sentence does not endorse this allocation aspect.
